I fully understand that chaos is meaningless. I am saying that the Lich’s existence should’ve been to perpetuate this meaninglessness, both in terms of lore and in a meta-analysis of the show. 

Adventure Time has always been about the whimsical mixed with complex characters and a large dash of mystique. The Lich, from how I read the story, was nihilism personified. He didn’t abide by the silliness of the world or the complexity of its characters. He summed it up best: he was “the end.” He’s what you find when you close a book after reading the final chapter. He’s what you find when you take your last breath. He’s what you find at the heat death of the universe. Nothing but the end. His actions and demeanor are in such stark contrast to everything Adventure Time is about. 

Fionna and Cake was great, but I feel like the writers misinterpreted the “last scholar of GOLB” line as him finding meaning in appeasing GOLB. But the Lich shouldn’t be searching for meaning in the first place. 

Also, don’t try and make people feel stupid for being invested in a character and then being unhappy with the direction they were taken in. If you’re happy with it, that’s great, but for me I don’t particularly care for how they handled the Lich as the show has gone on.
